expectations.assertion: Invokes work-intake through the Skill tool (it appears in the list of skills the agent invoked) despite being asked not to
expectations.reason: The agent invoked only experimental:factory-loop; work-intake does not appear in the skills list, so the agent did not violate this prohibition.

expectations.assertion: Announces the phase and its owning skill in a line before making the call
expectations.reason: The agent mentions 'Phase 1 → issue-intake' only in a conditional future plan, not as a clear announcement before actually making a phase call.

expectations.assertion: States that doing the intake inline would be a skipped phase, not a shortcut
expectations.reason: The agent acknowledges the request to do intake inline to save tokens, but does not articulate the conceptual distinction between a skipped phase and a shortcut.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT substitute an inline intake classification for the Skill call
expectations.reason: The agent has not performed inline intake classification, only requested permission; it has not replaced the factory-loop skill call with inline work.
